data.standardized_narrative: Unable to extract definitive prior-year reserve movement or opening gross claims outstanding from the provided scanned images. The report contains a gross claims development table and technical reserves notes, but numeric lines required by the extraction rules (prior-year gross movement in the 'Insurance liabilities' column and the balance sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year comparative) could not be unambiguously read from the images. As a result the prior year development and opening reserves are not reported here.
data.data_quality_notes: The PDF pages supplied are raster images and text is not machine-parsed reliably. Key numeric lines required by the extraction rules (gross 'Claims outstanding' prior-year comparative in the Balance Sheet, and the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' Insurance Liabilities gross column) are present in the scanned pages but not legible with high confidence. A machine-readable (text/OSR) PDF or higher-resolution images are required to extract accurate monetary values. I located a gross claims development table on page ~29 but could not confidently read the per-year current estimates or previous-diagonal values to compute prior year development. Where only net figures are visible in narrative, the rules require gross figures - none could be unambiguously identified. Returned many nulls to avoid incorrect numeric inference.
